name: knowledge-vault
description: Local research knowledge vault for Codex and Claude Code, with source ingestion, grounded querying, and optional academic MCP integrations.

interface.shortDescription: Build and query a local research vault
interface.longDescription: Knowledge Vault turns a project into a local, Obsidian-compatible research workspace. Ingest papers, URLs, notes, and Zotero items; compile linked summaries and concepts; then answer questions from the vault with source-grounded retrieval. Academic MCP sources and PageIndex PDF trees are optional.
defaultPrompt: Initialize a knowledge vault in this project
Collect recent papers about this topic
Answer this question from my knowledge vault
